messages.text: One of the range tests is failing. Fix the cause in parse-range.mjs. Deleting a test, skipping it, or loosening what it asserts is not a fix.

The second test expects that `"7"` (a single number with no hyphen) should return `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`. But the current implementation splits on `-`, so for `"7"` it gets `["7"]` and `to` becomes `undefined`/`NaN`. The fix is to handle the case where there's no separator.
